nodes.label: UzCasting Premium Mobile Platform Specification V2
nodes.rationale: The principal version of the four: it carries the approved design system with HEX values, the navigation and role system, the development stages and the QA checklist.

nodes.label: Ten Directions (V2)
nodes.rationale: Actors, models, bloggers, influencers, musicians, dancers, photo/video, styling, courses and casting announcements.

nodes.label: Home Architecture (V2)
nodes.rationale: Hero premiere banner, today's premieres carousel, popular creators, casting announcements, Premium CTA, search with smart filter and personalized recommendations.

nodes.label: Creator Catalog (V2)
nodes.rationale: Filters by city, age range, category and experience with sorting by popular, new or recommended.

nodes.label: Creator Profile as Casting CV (V2)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly not a social profile - it is a professional casting CV with portfolio, videos, projects and statistics.

nodes.label: Casting Feed and Casting Detail (V2)
nodes.rationale: Search, location, category, deadline, paid/unpaid badge, save, recommended castings and one-tap apply; detail adds requirements, payment, required media and application status.

nodes.label: Premyera Module (V2)
nodes.rationale: Series/shows/films with a PREMIYERA badge, 5000 sum price, exclusivity timer, trailer, genre, creator and episode list.

nodes.label: Episode Detail (V2)
nodes.rationale: Locked episode cards, purchase CTA, and an already-purchased state that turns into Watch.

nodes.label: Video Player (V2)
nodes.rationale: Adaptive streaming, continue watching, next episode, subtitles, quality, fullscreen and report problem.

nodes.label: To'lov / Payment (V2)
nodes.rationale: Click, Payme, Uzum Bank, Visa and Mastercard with order summary, secure payment state and a success receipt.

nodes.label: Premium Subscription Module (V2)
nodes.rationale: Monthly and annual plans alongside the per-episode price - the source of the unresolved dual monetization model.

nodes.label: Profil / Balans with Role-Based UI (V2)
nodes.rationale: One profile screen carrying balance, purchases, applications, projects, the creator dashboard entry, withdraw and settings, shown according to role.

nodes.label: Creator Dashboard (V2)
nodes.rationale: Upload, episodes, views, purchases, gross revenue, platform share, creator share, available balance and withdrawal.

nodes.label: Premium Premiere Business Model (V2)
nodes.rationale: Five-step chain from a free first episode on YouTube/Instagram, through the 'watch the continuation on UzCasting for 5000 sum' CTA, to payment and a creator/platform share, with refund and revenue-share terms named as open items.

nodes.label: Premium Design System and Palette (V2 p.18)
nodes.rationale: Deep Black #07070D, Midnight #11111F, Neon Purple #7C3AED, Magenta #EC4899, Electric Cyan #22D3EE, Gold #F5C542, White #FFFFFF, with 8-16px spacing, 14-22px card radius, 44px+ touch targets, one main CTA, typography hierarchy, minimum 1080px images, dark mode first, glow in moderation, and price plus locked status visible at a glance.

nodes.label: Navigation + Role System (V2 p.19)
nodes.rationale: User gets Home/Casting/Premyera/Xabarlar/Profil; Creator additionally gets Creator Dashboard, Upload, Revenue and Withdraw; Admin is a separate web panel.

nodes.label: Backend / API Requirements (V2)
nodes.rationale: Requires access-controlled streaming over a CDN rather than public file links - the clause behind the DRM versus signed-URL question.

nodes.label: Development Stages and Process (V2 p.20)
nodes.rationale: Stage 1 Android with Uzbek/Russian covering core casting, profiles, payments, messaging and premieres; stage 2 iOS, English and advanced monetization. Process runs research, IA, wireframe, high-fidelity Figma, prototype, developer handoff, QA and store release.

nodes.label: Developer Handoff - Figma Final Source of Truth (V2)
nodes.rationale: Every screen must ship its loading, empty, error, success, locked, purchased and offline states, which is the clause that makes design a blocker for development.

nodes.label: QA Checklist (V2 p.20)
nodes.rationale: Login/OTP, casting filters, application flow, playback, locked episode, payment success/failure, duplicate purchase protection, balance/revenue, notifications, language switch, device testing, performance and security.
